abstract: Choose, configure and validate prefix-cache and KV-aware request routing across LLM replicas. Covers the llm-d inference scheduler and Gateway API Inference Extension, vLLM production-stack, SGLang Model Gateway, NVIDIA Dynamo's KV router and AIBrix, with approximate versus precise modes, exact flags and plugin parameters, engine-side block size and KV-event settings, validation, security and a numerics gate via llm-evals. References are split into a router matrix and engine-side guidance.
